asset_heavy.reason: Online marketplaces and software; assets sold in place or by consignment, no heavy plants or fleets needed to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Typical auction lots are varied surplus items and fees are modest and frequent, though some equipment lots are large.

cyclical_demand.reason: Surplus disposal continues in downturns; closures and liquidations increase supply, and government surplus sales are steady.

large_customers.reason: Sellers are Fortune 1000 enterprises and government agencies (GovDeals, Ohio, Iowa DOT, ADM, Ferguson).

notes: Business model is mostly marketplace/auction services; product answer reflects AssetZone SaaS and resale of surplus goods.

offers_products.reason: Operates marketplaces and AssetZone SaaS; also buys and resells some surplus goods in its own inventory.

offers_services.reason: Consultative surplus management, valuation, compliance, marketing and sale of assets for enterprise and government sellers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its marketplace platforms, buyer network and technology, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat sellers like government agencies and enterprises list surplus continually, and repeat bidders buy; many are ongoing programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Millions of bidders include individuals buying vehicles, equipment, collectibles, art and retail goods on its marketplaces.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sellers are enterprises and government agencies; business bidders buy industrial equipment and inventory.
